concepts.concept_description: Road disruption/status within relevant Annex 2.1 road branches, limited to the conditional scope of this requirement.
concepts.applicability_conditions: Applies only where Article 5(2) makes the named profile applicable.
concepts.source_basis: EU-2017-1926-SF-A05-P02; M06_B02_HUMAN_REVIEW.md C04; M06_B02_POST_HUMAN_REVIEW.md; human decision ACCEPT_WITH_LIMITATIONS. Legal/source basis: Article 5(2), consolidated 2024-03-04. Future technical mapping basis is separate and excluded from this concept definition.
concepts.review_justification: Human decision on C04 accepts a bounded road-status concept under the conditional requirement.
concepts.limitations: Does not cover all Annex 2.1/2.2 categories; exact applicable category/profile and version remain open.
concepts.notes: M06-B02A authorized concept persistence; functional/legal concept only.

concepts.concept_description: Dynamic road-network status and disruption within the bounded road-status concept. It does not cover all dynamic road data or travel-time concepts.
concepts.source_basis: EU-2017-1926-SF-A05-P01-ROAD; M06_B02_HUMAN_REVIEW.md C01; M06_B02_POST_HUMAN_REVIEW.md; human decision ACCEPT_WITH_LIMITATIONS. Legal/source basis: Article 5(1)(a), consolidated 2024-03-04. Future technical mapping basis is separate and excluded from this concept definition.
concepts.review_justification: Human decision on C01 accepts a bounded road-status concept; exact profile and legal successor linkage remain limitations.
concepts.limitations: Exact applicable category/profile and version are not fixed. The 2015/962 source citation remains literal; current RTTI context is not a legal substitution.
concepts.notes: M06-B02A authorized concept persistence; functional/legal concept only.

concepts.concept_description: Availability/location of shared vehicles, preserving distinctions among vehicle modes and categories.
concepts.applicability_conditions: Applies only where Article 5(2) makes the named profile applicable.
concepts.source_basis: EU-2017-1926-SF-A05-P02; M06_B02_POST_HUMAN_REVIEW.md U02; human decision KEEP_UNRESOLVED. Legal/source basis: Article 5(2), consolidated 2024-03-04. No technical source is used as primary concept basis.
concepts.review_justification: Human decision keeps the concept unresolved; no common profile/category crosswalk was established.
concepts.limitations: Requires future mode/category decomposition; no capability or mapping is authorized.
concepts.notes: UNRESOLVED is a concept state, not evidence of missing data or audit result.

concepts.concept_description: Availability of parking spaces, without asserting a common treatment for on-street and off-street parking.
concepts.applicability_conditions: Applies only where Article 5(2) makes the named profile applicable.
concepts.source_basis: EU-2017-1926-SF-A05-P02; M06_B02_POST_HUMAN_REVIEW.md U03; human decision PARTIAL. Legal/source basis: Article 5(2), consolidated 2024-03-04. No technical source is used as primary concept basis.
concepts.review_justification: Human-reviewed state is PARTIAL; no ACCEPTED/REJECTED outcome was assigned.
concepts.limitations: Exact profile/version/elements and on/off-street applicability remain unresolved; no capability or mapping is authorized.
concepts.notes: Concept state PARTIAL records incomplete scope research, not absence of data.

concepts.concept_name: Passenger real-time service status and disruption
concepts.concept_description: Real-time status of public passenger services, including delay, cancellation and disruption information within the human-reviewed concept scope.
concepts.applicability_conditions: Applies only where Article 5(2) makes the named profile applicable.
concepts.source_basis: EU-2017-1926-SF-A05-P02; M06_B02_HUMAN_REVIEW.md C07; M06_B02_POST_HUMAN_REVIEW.md; human decision ACCEPT_WITH_LIMITATIONS. Legal/source basis: Article 5(2), consolidated 2024-03-04. Future technical mapping basis is separate and excluded from this concept definition.
concepts.review_justification: Human decision on C07 accepts the bounded passenger real-time status concept.
concepts.limitations: Does not establish every mode, Annex element, profile or all P02 scope.
concepts.notes: M06-B02A authorized concept persistence; profile versions are not part of concept identity.

concepts.concept_description: Status of availability of access facilities at a transport node, such as lifts or escalators when the reviewed item applies.
concepts.applicability_conditions: Applies only where Article 5(2) makes the named profile applicable.
concepts.source_basis: EU-2017-1926-SF-A05-P02; M06_B02_HUMAN_REVIEW.md C08; M06_B02_POST_HUMAN_REVIEW.md; human decision ACCEPT_WITH_LIMITATIONS. Legal/source basis: Article 5(2), consolidated 2024-03-04. Future technical mapping basis is separate and excluded from this concept definition.
concepts.review_justification: Human decision on C08 accepts the bounded facility/access-node concept.
concepts.limitations: The Annex-item to service-element crosswalk is incomplete; no complete facility coverage is implied.
concepts.notes: M06-B02A authorized concept persistence; profile-specific terminology is excluded from identity.

concepts.concept_description: Parking tariff information within the reviewed Annex 2.2(a) candidate scope.

concepts.review_justification: Human-reviewed state is PARTIAL; no ACCEPTED/REJECTED outcome was assigned.
